WITH site_scan_suitability AS (
    SELECT 
        t1.zoneregistry AS location_id,
        t1.zonelabel AS location_name,
        AVG(
            (
                CASE 
                    WHEN t2.ambictemp BETWEEN -5 AND 40 THEN 100
                    WHEN t2.ambictemp BETWEEN -10 AND -5 THEN 75
                    WHEN t2.ambictemp BETWEEN 40 AND 50 THEN 50
                    ELSE 0
                END
            ) + 
            (
                CASE 
                    WHEN t2.humepct BETWEEN 30 AND 70 THEN 100
                    WHEN t2.humepct BETWEEN 20 AND 30 THEN 75
                    WHEN t2.humepct BETWEEN 70 AND 80 THEN 50
                    ELSE 0
                END
            ) + 
            (
                CASE 
                    WHEN t2.illumelux > 50000 THEN 100
                    WHEN t2.illumelux BETWEEN 30000 AND 50000 THEN 75
                    WHEN t2.illumelux BETWEEN 10000 AND 30000 THEN 50
                    ELSE 0
                END
            ) + 
            (
                CASE 
                    WHEN t2.geosignal = 'Excellent' THEN 100
                    WHEN t2.geosignal = 'Good' THEN 75
                    WHEN t2.geosignal = 'Poor' THEN 50
                    ELSE 0
                END
            ) + 
            (
                CASE 
                    WHEN t2.trackstatus = 'Fixed' THEN 100
                    WHEN t2.trackstatus = 'None' THEN 50
                    ELSE 0
                END
            ) + 
            (
                CASE 
                    WHEN t2.linkstatus = 'Connected' THEN 100
                    WHEN t2.linkstatus = 'Disconnected' THEN 50
                    ELSE 0
                END
            ) + 
            (
                CASE 
                    WHEN t2.photomap = '90%' THEN 100
                    WHEN t2.photomap = '60%' THEN 75
                    WHEN t2.photomap = '80%' THEN 50
                    ELSE 0
                END
            )
        ) / 7 AS average_scanning_suitability
    FROM 
        sites AS t1
    JOIN 
        scanenvironment AS t2 ON t1.zoneregistry = t2.zoneref
    GROUP BY 
        t1.zoneregistry, t1.zonelabel
)
SELECT 
    location_id,
    location_name,
    average_scanning_suitability
FROM 
    site_scan_suitability
ORDER BY 
    average_scanning_suitability DESC;

You have a budget of 22.0 bird-coins. Use your tools to explore the database, clarify ambiguities with the user, and submit your final SQL efficiently.

events.sql:
WITH site_scan_suitability AS (
    SELECT 
        t1.zoneregistry AS location_id,
        t1.zonelabel AS location_name,
        AVG(
            (
                CASE 
                    WHEN t2.ambictemp BETWEEN -5 AND 40 THEN 100
                    WHEN t2.ambictemp BETWEEN -10 AND -5 THEN 75
                    WHEN t2.ambictemp BETWEEN 40 AND 50 THEN 50
                    ELSE 0
                END
            ) + 
            (
                CASE 
                    WHEN t2.humepct BETWEEN 30 AND 70 THEN 100
                    WHEN t2.humepct BETWEEN 20 AND 30 THEN 75
                    WHEN t2.humepct BETWEEN 70 AND 80 THEN 50
                    ELSE 0
                END
            ) + 
            (
                CASE 
                    WHEN t2.illumelux > 50000 THEN 100
                    WHEN t2.illumelux BETWEEN 30000 AND 50000 THEN 75
                    WHEN t2.illumelux BETWEEN 10000 AND 30000 THEN 50
                    ELSE 0
                END
            ) + 
            (
                CASE 
                    WHEN t2.geosignal = 'Excellent' THEN 100
                    WHEN t2.geosignal = 'Good' THEN 75
                    WHEN t2.geosignal = 'Poor' THEN 50
                    ELSE 0
                END
            ) + 
            (
                CASE 
                    WHEN t2.trackstatus = 'Fixed' THEN 100
                    WHEN t2.trackstatus = 'None' THEN 50
                    ELSE 0
                END
            ) + 
            (
                CASE 
                    WHEN t2.linkstatus = 'Connected' THEN 100
                    WHEN t2.linkstatus = 'Disconnected' THEN 50
                    ELSE 0
                END
            ) + 
            (
                CASE 
                    WHEN t2.photomap = '90%' THEN 100
                    WHEN t2.photomap = '60%' THEN 75
                    WHEN t2.photomap = '80%' THEN 50
                    ELSE 0
                END
            )
        ) / 7 AS average_scanning_suitability
    FROM 
        sites AS t1
    JOIN 
        scanenvironment AS t2 ON t1.zoneregistry = t2.zoneref
    GROUP BY 
        t1.zoneregistry, t1.zonelabel
)
SELECT 
    location_id,
    location_name,
    average_scanning_suitability
FROM 
    site_scan_suitability
ORDER BY 
    average_scanning_suitability DESC;
